observations.finding: The former lumpy shell is replaced by a continuous, recognizable dome from the MLZ courtyard; dark perimeter facades remain visible below it.
Close views reveal the new pale frames, glazing and tan brick, but photographed low perimeter structures and source triangles obscure much of the base.
Smooth silhouette and panel grid are clear. Metal remains too uniform and seams too dark/regular for visual acceptance.
Aerial views retain the surrounding campus layout and the wider annular roof. Adjacent FRMII and smaller structures still expose coarse geometry.
Sunset lighting works; the unresolved low perimeter geometry remains conspicuous.
All six standing/body checks pass. Captures are at the sunset time retained from the last camera; they are not an independent daytime walking-material assessment.
